mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines over the prior month, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 0.5% for two consecutive months, it signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 0.5% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) over the prior two months signals robust consumer spending that boosts corporate earnings expectations, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS rise over the prior two months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 8.5%), weak labor market conditions suppress consumer spending and corporate profits, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 8.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the prior two months indicates strengthening manufacturing activity that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO rises over the prior two months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 650.0 (thousands of units) for two consecutive months, it signals a robust housing market that stimulates consumer confidence and corporate investment, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST > 650.0 for two consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 225.0), when the federal funds rate remains above 0.5%, the central bank's reluctance to ease policy despite inflationary pressures leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: high inflation and restrictive monetary policy
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 225.0 and FEDFUNDS > 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in employment (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment (UNRATE) over the prior month signals a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls over the prior month, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 12-month rolling window.
